description: Diff policy creates, updates, and deletes without writing them (POST /v1/policies/apply). dryRun is forced to true and cannot be turned off. Nothing is stored and no audit entry is written. prune only marks missing policies for deletion in the plan. Requires an org-wide LIVE API key; a TEST key or an agent-bound key is refused with 403. This tool does not apply the plan.

policies.description: Policies to diff against the stored set. Each item needs name, action, and decision. Nothing is written.

action.description: Action family, not an event action such as EXPORT_DATA.

approverRoles.description: Roles that may approve a REVIEW raised by this policy. Empty means owners and admins.

condition.description: When the policy matches. Omitted matches every event with this action and resource.

action.description: Event action (READ_DATA and the others) or an action family. Matched against the event action and its family.

agentIds.description: Agent ids. The event agent must be one of these ids.

allOf.description: Matches when every nested condition matches. An empty allOf matches.

anyOf.description: Matches when at least one nested condition matches. An empty anyOf does not.

containsSensitiveData.description: Whether the action is treated as containing sensitive data.

destination.description: EXTERNAL matches an external destination. INTERNAL matches an internal one. This is not the event destination enum.

dlpTypes.description: Sensitive-data types. Allowed values: CPF, CNPJ, RG, CNH, PIX_KEY, PHONE_BR, CEP, CREDIT_CARD, EMAIL, HEALTH_DATA, API_KEY, PRIVATE_KEY.

lgpdCategories.description: LGPD categories. Allowed values: IDENTIFICATION, CONTACT, LOCATION, FINANCIAL, HEALTH, COMPANY, CREDENTIALS.

maxRecords.description: recordsAffected is less than or equal to this value.

minRecords.description: recordsAffected is greater than or equal to this value.

minRiskScore.description: Risk score from 0 to 100. The condition matches at or above this score.

outsideBusinessHours.description: Monday to Friday 09:00-18:00 in the organization time zone, inverted.

decision.description: Result when the policy matches. Allowed values: ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK.

description.description: What the policy is for. Optional. At most 500 characters.

enabled.description: Omitted defaults to true on the API.

mode.description: Omitted defaults to ENFORCE on the API. Allowed values: ENFORCE, MONITOR.

name.description: Policy name. Unique in the organization.

resource.description: Resource classification. ANY, null, and omitted match every classification.

prune.description: When true, the plan marks stored policies whose names are missing from policies for deletion. Nothing is deleted.

name: plan_policy_changes

changes.description: Creates, updates, deletes, and unchanged names.

dryRun.description: Always true. The plan is not applied.

title: Plan policy changes
